## Description {#details}

<p>Names for the checks of the comparison operators, looked up as the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">apply()</span> functions look them up.</p>


<p>The using-declarations make the standard operators visible to unqualified lookup, in addition to those found by argument-dependent lookup, as in the bodies of the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">apply()</span> functions; the concept checks that the comparison is well-formed, without instantiating the bodies.</p>
